bible_refs.note: Quoted: Levi, receiving tenths, has been tithed; still in the father's loin when Melchizedek met him.
Those who come out of the loin of Abraham.
LXX Job 40:11 of Behemoth (read of the devil): strength in loin and navel of belly.

choices.why: The argument from Abraham's seed and Job 40 needs the generative sense.

lemmas.lexica: LSJ: loin, as seat of generation

pass_a_gloss: What the loins having been girded is we shall be taught from other sayings of the writing. The apostle, recounting the things from loin of Abraham blessed by Melchizedek, says thus: And Levi who takes tenths has been tithed; for he was still in the father's loin when Melchizedek met him; and elsewhere he says: Though having come out from the loin of Abraham; and in Job he says about the devil: And his strength is in loin and in navel of belly.
pass_b_english: What it is to have the loins girded we shall be taught from other sayings of Scripture. The apostle, recounting the things from the loin of Abraham who was blessed by Melchizedek, says: "And Levi, who receives tenths, has been tithed; for he was still in the loin of the father when Melchizedek met him." (Hebrews 7:9–10) And elsewhere he says: "Though they had come out of the loin of Abraham." (Hebrews 7:5) And in Job he says of the devil: "And his strength is in loin and in the navel of belly." (Job 40:16)
